class.name: IfcExternallyDefinedHatchStyle
class.brief_description: Definition from ISO/CD 10303-46:1992 : The externally defined hatch style is an entity which makes an external reference to a hatching style. NOTE: The allowable values for the name source and item reference, by which the externally defined hatch style is identified, need to be determined by implementer agreements. NOTE: Corresponding ISO 10303 name: fill_style_select. Please refer to ISO/IS 10303
